# Open the Partner Workshop

Open one source-grounded workshop canvas without starting workshop tasks or resetting saved progress.

Use the **partner-workshop** skill. If skill discovery is unavailable, read
[the launch skill](../../skills/workshop/partner-workshop/SKILL.md) and follow its preparation, discovery, open and state-check flow.

Success means the preparation check passes, the `partner-workshop-guide` panel opens, and `get_state` returns the six-stage, 270-minute agenda. Report missing tools or assets explicitly; do not substitute a different host or automatically install dependencies.
